Subject: Post-call: Pilot readiness & data-handling checklist — Orbital Health

Hi Deepa / Samir —

Thanks again for a constructive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth heading into the pilot kickoff: see items below and the attached artifacts.

1) Agreed pilot scope (2-week technical POC)
   - Use case: HPI-to-summary assistant for prior-authorization teams (batch + near-real-time).
   - Input types: clinician notes (de-identified subset) + structured claim metadata.
   - Expected volume during POC: ~50k tokens/day peak, ~1k request/day.

2) Success metrics (agreed)
   - Quality: ≥ 85% accuracy on the 50-case prompt-eval suite (we'll co-create the prompt set).
   - Latency: 95th percentile < 250ms for interactive calls (sequence length ~512 tokens).
   - Cost guardrail: target unit cost ≤ $0.45 / 1k tokens for inference during the pilot.

3) Security & data handling
   - You requested no PHI to be sent to hosted service. For the POC we will run in Redwood Dedicated (isolated tenancy) and redact direct identifiers before transit.
   - We will provide a short data-sharing matrix and a minimal ingestion script; you will provide an S3 bucket with temporary read-only credentials.

4) Owners & roles
   - Customer: Deepa (POC sponsor) + Samir (engineering lead) — responsible for S3 access and sample dataset.
   - Redwood: Avery (AM / kickoff owner), Marissa (solutions engineer / prompts & evals), Karthik (infra lead — Dedicated provisioning).

5) Timeline & next steps
   - By 2026-11-17: Orbital to share sanitized sample dataset (5–10 cases) and temporary S3 path.
   - 2026-11-19: Redwood to provision Dedicated environment and surface initial model candidate + quantization suggestions.
   - 2026-11-22: Kickoff call (30 min) — confirm eval rubric and run first prompt-eval pass.

6) Action items (owner)
   - Deepa: Provide sample dataset, SOC2 questionnaire answers, and point of contact for procurement.
   - Samir: Create S3 bucket and share ARN + temp creds with Karthik.
   - Marissa: Draft initial prompt bank and eval cases (will attach V1).
   - Avery: Share SOW stub and schedule kickoff.

Attachments: orbital_poc_mip_v1.xlsx (pilot milestones & success gates), data_sharing_matrix.pdf (fields & redaction guidance), sow_orbital_v1.docx (SOW stub).

If this aligns with your understanding, please reply with confirmation and the S3 path (or an ETA). I’ll schedule the provisioning and kickoff once we have the sample dataset.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this running.

Best,
Avery Johnson
